gwt.given: a model property of type Guid? (nullable Guid) whose value is Guid.Empty
gwt.when: the caller invokes the nullable-Guid scalar input-parameter helper of SqlParameterCollectionExtensions for that property
gwt.then: the appended SQL Server parameter's Value is Guid.Empty, not DBNull.Value, because the nullable value's HasValue is true; by design only the non-nullable overload treats Guid.Empty as the database-null sentinel, since a nullable caller has a real null to express database null
